messages:
ashley: Heads up — release cut window in 45m. Staging CI is failing on image extraction and deploy-bot shows promotion paused. Anyone able to triage?
ci-bot: build/4321: ERROR: buildkit: tar extraction failed: unexpected EOF while reading archive
ci-bot: logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/4321
sam: saw it. buildkit errors look like blob layer TTL eviction on the s3-proxy during parallel upload fanout.
priya: could be the multipart-throttle we saw last week. If it's the same, we can pin to last-good image sha and do a manual promote.
leo: quick check: `gsutil stat` shows the final object size is smaller than expected — incomplete upload. s3-proxy returning 200 before backend flush. Suggest pin to sha256:abcd1234 and promote manually if we want to keep the cut.
ashley: timeline: 45m till window. Options: (1) pin + manual promote, (2) wait for retry and hope CI recovers, (3) abort cut. Thoughts?
sam: prefer pin+manual promote. I'll build and push a pinned image and draft a short blurb for release notes.
priya: once sam uploads, I can run deploy actions. @deploy-bot please standby for manual promote.
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: artifact checksum mismatch for registry.redwood/rls:v2026.1-pinned. Manual override requires `--manual-override` and a release owner approval.
ashley: I can approve. Priya, pls attach the checksum and artifact link so I can sign off.
priya: uploading checksum + artifact now: https://storage.redwood/internal/artifacts/rls-v2026.1-pinned/checksum.txt
sam: checksum matches locally. Deploy-bot is failing because the remote reports a different content-length (eventual consistency on s3-proxy). We can retry with manual override if we accept the risk.
leo: pragmatically, either wait 2h for object to converge or use manual-override. Suggest doing override now and open a follow-up infra ticket — safer than aborting the cut.
ashley: decision required. I'm approving manual-override for this promotion. Priya, proceed when ready.
priya: running: `deploy-bot promote --image sha256:abcd1234 --force --manual-override --note "pin due to buildkit s3-proxy ttl/fanout"` 
priya: promote logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/promote/9876
deploy-bot: Promotion started. Canary policy: 5% eu-west for 10m. Rollback policy active: immediate rollback on >5% error spike or sustained tail latency >2s.
priya: Canary 10m completed — no errors. Moving canary to 50%.
sam: FYI: image variant built during the race is ~2.8% larger; cost team flagged a potential 3% token cost bump for this image. We'll mark as temporary pin.
ashley: add to release notes: "Temporary pin due to build artifact race on s3-proxy; follow-up infra work scheduled."
leo: opened INFRA-4923 to track s3-proxy TTL/fanout fixes and multipart-throttle work. Assigning to infra team.
ashley: promotion finished successfully. Thanks all. Closing thread.
ci-bot: automated: deploy-tracking: release v2026.1 promoted by priya at 1747894595
